title: Evaluation of Immune Function in Biliary Atresia Children With Prolonged Jaundice
brief_summary: Null hypothesis of this study: Biliary atresia patients with cholestatic jaundice do not have systemic immunity defect.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Biliary patients older than 1-year-old status post Kasai operation.

Exclusion Criteria:

Received liver transplantation, immunosuppresant, systemic immunoglobulin (within 6 months) and obvious infectious episode (within 2 weeks).
